turns.q: What's the return policy if it turns out not to be right for me?
turns.replyTail:
IF IT TURNS OUT NOT TO BE RIGHT FOR ME?
If an item isn’t right, you can generally start a return within 14 DAYS OF RECEIVING IT through our RETURN PORTAL. It must be unworn or unused, with tags attached, in its original packaging, and accompanied by proof of purchase. A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from refunds.
Before choosing a first item, note that BODYSUITS AND SALE ITEMS AREN’T RETURNABLE. International orders are also non-returnable, except orders to Canada.
